sloka: अस्माकम् अपि मुख्यानि फलानि इमानि हे द्विज ।गृहाण विप्र भद्रम् ते भक्षयस्व च मा अचिरम् ॥१-१०-१९॥
transliteration: asmākam api mukhyāni phalāni imāni he dvija ।gṛhāṇa vipra bhadram te bhakṣayasva ca mā aciram ॥1-10-19॥

translations.english: 'O brahmin, these are excellent fruits. May prosperity be to you. Accept them and eat them without delay.'
